utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Case number IT-00-41-PT, the Prosecutor versus Pasko Ljubicic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Madam. May I have the appearances, please. Mr. Harmon.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Yes. Good afternoon, Mr. President. Good afternoon, counsel. My name is Mark Harmon. Appearing with me is my case manager, Ms. Donnica Henry Frijlink.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. May I have appearances for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Tomislav Jonjic. I am an attorney-at-law from Zagreb. And I am Defence counsel for Mr. Pasko Ljubicic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Sir, Mr. Ljubicic, can you hear me in a language that you can understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, yes, I can and I understand you completely.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. You may be seated. I believe that we are all aware that at this stage of the pre-trial phase -- we are almost at the end of this pre-trial phase, rather, or it is the end of the pre-trial phase. I have drafted the report, and I have sent it to the President of the Tribunal in order for him to establish a date for the beginning of the trial. I would like to invite the parties to raise -- if there are any questions to be raised at this point regarding any matter that they would like to raise. I am going to turn to the Prosecutor. Mr. Harmon, would you like to raise a particular point at this stage of the procedure? Would you like to inform the Chamber of something in particular?

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: I have nothing to inform the Chamber about, Your Honour. Thank you for the invitation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Mr. Harmon. Mr. Jonjic, would you have anything to tell us?

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Previous translation continues] ... Your Honour, the same applies to the Defence. The Defence has nothing to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. Please correct me, Mr. Jonjic, if I'm mistaken, but I believe that there was a pending motion regarding the provisional release of your client.

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That's right, Your Honour. That's a motion that is still pending, has not been decided upon yet. This is one of the matters that I intended to raise with Mr. Harhoff prior to this conference. Unfortunately, he is absent. And I suggest that we wait until next week, when he returns, and then I will discuss the matter with him and with Mr. Harmon.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, sir. I would like to inquire about the health of Mr. Ljubicic, and I would like to ask him if he wishes to tell us of his current condition rather in a private conference or not.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There is no need to go into private session. My health is good, and I have nothing to raise in connection with my detention.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You would like to bring to the attention of the Chamber a particular information? Would you have something to tell the Chamber at this point in time, aside from your health, for instance?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, there is nothing specific that I would like to raise before Your Honour. I can only say that it's been a long time now that I've been in detention. I can mention the motion for release until the start of trial, whenever it may be. I have conveyed this wish of mine to my Defence counsel on several occasions, regardless of when this trial will start, I will be at everyone's disposal. There is nothing other than that that I would like to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. You may be seated, Mr. Ljubicic. I would like to ensure you that the Chamber heard you and will examine carefully what you've said. This being said, I believe that since the parties have nothing else to add -- but rather, before the adjournment, I would like to wish a happy Easter to all of you. And this being said, the -- we are -- we stand adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
